row.name: ReelstripParser
row.source: function ReelstripParser(){function getMessageValue(id){for(var i=0,l=m_aServerResponse.length;i<l;i++)if(m_aServerResponse[i]==id)return m_aServerResponse[i+1];return""}function removeDelimiter(sMessage,sDelimiter){return sMessage.charAt(sMessage.length-1)==sDelimiter&&(sMessage=sMessage.substr(0,sMessage.length-1)),sMessage}function ProcessReelStripResponse(){getMessageValue("RST_0")&&(m_cResponse.RST_0=TranslateReelString()),GetReelStripChanges()}function TranslateReelString(){var src=getMessageValue("RST_0");src=removeDelimiter(src,"|");var res=[],reels=[];reels=src.split("|");for(var reelIndex=0,l=reels.length;reelIndex<l;reelIndex++){var reel=reels[reelIndex],reelstrip=reel.split(">");reelstrip[1]=removeDelimiter(reelstrip[1],";");var symbols=CreateDecodedString(reelstrip[1],5,";").split(";");res[reelIndex]=symbols.map(Number)}return res}function GetReelStripChanges(){if(getMessageValue("RSIDS")){var sRSIDS=removeDelimiter(getMessageValue("RSIDS"),"|"),aRSCIDS=sRSIDS.split("|");m_cResponse.RSIDS=aRSCIDS.map(Number);for(var nID=0;nID<aRSCIDS.length;nID++)if("0"!=aRSCIDS[nID]){var aNewStrips=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(m_cResponse.RST_0)),sFullChanges=getMessageValue("RST_"+aRSCIDS[nID]);""!=sFullChanges&&(aNewStrips=GetFullStripsChanged(aNewStrips,sFullChanges));var sSymbolChanges=getMessageValue("RSC_"+aRSCIDS[nID]);""!=sSymbolChanges&&(aNewStrips=GetSymbolsChanged(aNewStrips,sSymbolChanges)),m_cResponse["RST_"+aRSCIDS[nID]]=aNewStrips}}}function GetFullStripsChanged(aNewStrips,sChanges){sChanges=removeDelimiter(sChanges,"|");for(var aChangeReelStrips=sChanges.split("|"),nChangedReel=0;nChangedReel<aChangeReelStrips.length;nChangedReel++){var aChangeStrip=aChangeReelStrips[nChangedReel].split(">"),nReel=Number(aChangeStrip[0]),symbols=CreateDecodedString(aChangeStrip[1],5,";").split(";");aNewStrips[nReel]=symbols.map(Number)}return aNewStrips}function GetSymbolsChanged(aNewStrips,sChanges){sChanges=removeDelimiter(sChanges,"|");for(var aChangeReelStrips=sChanges.split("|"),nChangedReel=0;nChangedReel<aChangeReelStrips.length;nChangedReel++)for(var aChangeStrip=aChangeReelStrips[nChangedReel].split(">"),nReel=Number(aChangeStrip[0]),aChanges=removeDelimiter(aChangeStrip[1],";").split(";"),nChange=0;nChange<aChanges.length;nChange++){var aIndivChange=CreateDecodedString(aChanges[nChange],10,":").split(":"),nPos=Number(aIndivChange[0]),nSymbol=Number(aIndivChange[1]);aNewStrips[nReel][nPos]=nSymbol}return aNewStrips}function CreateDecodedString(sEncodedString,nBitsPerNumber,sDelim){var sDecodedString,bEncoded=Number(getMessageValue("ENC")),nEncodedArray=sEncodedString.split(sDelim),sDecodedArray=[];if(1==bEncoded){for(var i=0;i<nEncodedArray.length;i++)sDecodedArray[i]=DecodeReelStripNumbers(parseInt(nEncodedArray[i],36),nBitsPerNumber,sDelim);return sDecodedString=sDecodedArray.join(sDelim)}return sEncodedString}function DecodeReelStripNumbers(nEncodedNumber,nBitsPerNumber,sDelim){for(var sDecodedString="",nBitsPerNumberCount=3,nNumberCountMask=Math.pow(2,nBitsPerNumberCount)-1,nNumberCount=nEncodedNumber&nNumberCountMask,nShift=nBitsPerNumberCount,nCount=0;nCount<nNumberCount;nCount++){var nNumberMask=Math.pow(2,nBitsPerNumber+nShift)-1;sDecodedString+=(nEncodedNumber&nNumberMask)>>nShift,nShift+=nBitsPerNumber,nCount<nNumberCount-1&&(sDecodedString+=sDelim)}return sDecodedString}var m_aServerResponse=[],m_cResponse={},self=this;self.processResponse=function(msg){m_aServerResponse=msg.split(/&|=/),ProcessReelStripResponse()},self.getNumSets=function(){return m_cResponse.RSIDS.length},self.getReelstripSet=function(id){return m_cResponse[id]},self.removeDelimiter=removeDelimiter}
